errors.text_span: 纵轴为“标题长度”，以整数刻度从1递增至50，单位为字符数，刻度间隔为1
errors.evidence: The description of the y-axis is misleading. It states the scale increments from 1 to 50 with an interval of 1, which implies a continuous, evenly spaced axis. The axis actually shows discrete, non-sequential, and unevenly spaced category labels (1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11, 13, 15, 23, 50).
